project.name: zapi-cli
project.description: Standalone cross-platform CLI binary providing a deterministic, scriptable interface to any Zoho product's REST APIs. Primary consumer is AI agents (GitHub Copilot CLI Skills, Claude Agent Skills). Manages multiple Zoho accounts, handles auth via a pluggable IAuthProvider interface (PAT in v1, OAuth2 in v2), and exposes a general-purpose HTTP API invoker where the caller supplies the full base URL at invocation time.

projects.name: ZapiCli
projects.responsibility: Entry point. Spectre.Console command wiring, Program.cs, DI registration. No business logic.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Core
projects.responsibility: All domain logic: AccountStore, PatAuthProvider, ApiClient, TraceWriter, TraceSession, TraceExporter, ZohoCorp domain-block utility, output contracts, error codes. No Spectre.Console dependency. Unit-testable with no OS or real HTTP dependencies.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Keychain
projects.responsibility: IKeychainProvider interface + OS platform implementations (macOS Security.framework, Windows advapi32, Linux libsecret) + AES-256-GCM encrypted-file fallback. No dependency on Core or ZapiCli.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Tests
projects.responsibility: xUnit unit tests for ZapiCli.Core and ZapiCli.Keychain using in-memory fakes. No real OS keychain or network access.

techStack.keychain: Direct P/Invoke to OS APIs — NO third-party NuGet keychain package

v1: IKeychainProvider + all platform implementations + AES-256-GCM fallback
account command group (add, list, remove, show, set-default, re-auth stub)
api call command (--base-url required, caller-supplied, no derivation)
Trace system (TraceWriter, TraceSession, TraceExporter, trace session commands)
v2: OAuth2 authentication (OAuthProvider, account re-auth fully activated)
